plugins.name: sap-abap-agent
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition: 25 module consultants + 1 researcher + 1 daily learner + 1 reviewer (28 agents total) with auto-scoring routing engine, CDS KB, SAP Docs Research, ABAP cloud connect, code review, clean code & extensibility. Install: /plugin marketplace add StormShynn/sap-abap-agent then /plugin install; see docs/onboarding-guide.md and docs/rollout-guide.md. Multi-system router: Public Cloud, Private Cloud, On-prem, BTP, RISE with SAP. Side-by-side with vibing-steampunk for deep analysis.
